data.standardized_narrative: During 2016 Syndicate 2007 strengthened prior-year reserves, with an estimated gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 61.3m (5.3% of opening gross claims outstanding). The reported net movement disclosed in the financial statements was an increase of GBP 33.1m in respect of 2014 and prior underwriting years (net of reinsurance). The principal drivers were an adverse re-estimation from smaller-scale natural catastrophe events and the impact of the Ogden discount rate revision, together with changes to reserve and accounting policies (deferred acquisition cost treatment) which influenced reserve presentation.
raw_causal_phrases: The Lord Chancellor's Ogden rate announcement, both in terms of timing and severity, has overshadowed our 2016 results.
resultant increases in reserves within our motor reinsurance and general liability classes have significantly eroded profits this year
there was a high incidence of these 'smaller scale' natural catastrophes
This includes an amount of GBP 33.1 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2014 and prior underwriting years
the revision of the Ogden rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% has resulted in a material impact to the result of the Syndicate
the managing agent reviewed the Syndicate's accounting policy relating to the treatment of deferred acquisition costs
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year strengthening (GBP 61.3m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative claims = cumulative payments + estimated balance to pay). The report explicitly states a net prior-year increase of GBP 33.1m (net of reinsurance). No single explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was given in the movement note; therefore the gross figure is derived from the triangle (confidence 0.8). Lob-level prior-year amounts are not quantified in the report and therefore left null; directions for Casualty/Motor are inferred from narrative referencing increases in motor reinsurance and general liability reserves. The claims triangle includes an aggregated '2010 & prior' column which was excluded from the triangle-based PYD calculation as required.
